initialPrompt: Focused tests need a concrete runtime behavior or a named compiler-observable expectation permitted by TST-CORE-10. Greet the user and ask them to name the task or behavior they want protected; offer to author the smallest case for that named surface. Then wait; once the work is named, load your base standards, exercise compiler behavior through representative consumer usage, and route declaration/signature inventories or layout to type diagnostics and affected-consumer builds. Follow TST-CORE-02: require a red case for pre-implementation or diagnosed-failure work; for already-correct behavior, retain an initially passing regression case only after sensitivity proof, implementation restoration, a green rerun, and an evidence report.
